name: CUNY Graduate Center
header:
CUNY Graduate Center
United States · Mathematics PhD
Rank verification is maintained separately.
Eligibility and preparation · Deadlines by stage · English and GRE · Academic records · Recommendation letters · Written
materials · Funding and fees · Conflicts and remaining checks · Faculty · Sources
Pay attention to
• Two references, unlike many three-letter programs.
• Five-year tuition support is not a universal stipend guarantee.
• Do not confuse CUNY Graduate Center PhD with CCNY master’s admissions.
• Faculty below form a verified research-fit shortlist, not a complete census. New-student supervision and 2027
leave/moves must be confirmed; paper dates describe the cited version.

sections.title: Eligibility and preparation
sections.text:
Eligibility for your route [Standing rule]
International applicants with appropriate undergraduate mathematics preparation are eligible; program
emphasizes topology, algebra, real/complex analysis and research preparation. UChicago degree is a suitable
route, with individual record reviewed. [s4] [s2]
Before submission [Standing rule]
Prepare academic applicant statement and optional personal statement; upload all institution records; arrange
two academic referees before January 1. No math-specific extra form listed. [s1] [s2] [s3]
Adviser contact [Unresolved]
No public requirement to secure an adviser before submitting was established in the admissions pages
checked. Use the research-fit shortlist for potential contacts and confirm 2027 availability/graduate supervision
eligibility. A faculty listing does not promise an opening. [s1] [s2] [s3]
Portal workflow [Standing rule]
Upload PDF components≤4MB; grayscale/black-and-white suggested. Checklist for receipt. Supporting
documents cannot arrive late. [s3]
Cycle verification [Conflict]
Annual January 1 rule, not explicitly 2027. Funding pages show mixed 2025/2026 effective-date labels and
March 2027 change; request 2027-28 offer figures. [s1] [s6]

sections.title: English and GRE
sections.text:
English requirement [Standing rule]
TOEFL iBT or IELTS only; Duolingo/other tests not accepted by GC. Official TOEFL reporting code 2113; no
universal score guarantees admission. Math-specific minimum unverified. [s2] [s3]
UChicago English exemption [Standing rule]
Completed postsecondary degree taught solely in English in United States satisfies exemption. Rule says
degree already held; if still completing UChicago degree when applying, obtain confirmation that expected
conferral qualifies. [s2] [s3]
GRE General [Standing rule]
Not required. Whether voluntary scores are reviewed or suppressed not stated in math deadline table. [s1]
GRE Mathematics [Standing rule]
Recommended, not listed as required. [s1]

sections.title: Recommendation letters
sections.text:
Number and type [Standing rule]
Two required for mathematics under general rule; math table lists no exception. Academic referees strongly
preferred; professional if unavailable. [s1] [s3]
Scholarship references [Unresolved]
All applicants automatically considered for institutional five-year merit packages; no extra reference identified
for ordinary package. Other scholarships require award-specific verification. [s4]
What sends the invitation [Unresolved]
System emails referees using addresses entered when completing application; exact save-versus-submit
trigger not stated. [s2]
Before versus after submission [Standing rule]
Submit application without waiting for letters; letters still due by deadline. After submission portal supports
reminders. [s3]
Receipt confirmation [Standing rule]
Application checklist shows received letters. [s3]
Updating and reusing letters [Unresolved]
After submission cannot self-add/correct referee emails; request changes via admissions@gc.cuny.edu,

potentially delayed. Interfolio allowed via its letter-specific email. Received-letter updates/prior-cycle reuse
unverified. [s3]

sections.title: Written materials
sections.text:
Academic CV / resume; Research proposal; Publications list; Course-list document; Other short
answers / materials [Unresolved]
The public mathematics and graduate-admissions pages checked do not establish a separate requirement or
permission to submit this item. Required/optional status, exact prompt, length, formatting and
upload-versus-link instructions remain unverified; check the current portal before drafting or sending an extra
document. [s1] [s2] [s3]
Statement of purpose [Standing rule]
Required uploaded applicant statement (faithful paraphrase): past education/experience,
academic/professional plans, reasons for graduate study, intended specialization, and other evidence of
academic ability. No universal hard maximum; FAQ suggests about 1000 words and math table adds no special
limit. Upload≤4MB; full prompt linked. [s1] [s2] [s3]
Personal / background statement [Standing rule]
Optional personal/background statement,≤250 words (paraphrase): experiences shaping scholarly identity and
positive contribution to Graduate Center community. Portal section; formatting not specified. [s2]
Research-interest statement [Standing rule]
Include intended specialization/research agenda and program fit in applicant statement; no separate math
research-interest essay listed. [s2] [s3]
Writing sample / thesis / research summary [Unresolved]
Mathematics requirements table does not list writing sample; do not import requirements from English or
CCNY’s separate program. Whether optional papers may be uploaded/linked unverified. [s1]
Scholarship essays [Unresolved]
Ordinary institutional funding considered automatically; no separate ordinary-package essay identified. Other
awards’ prompts/requirements unverified. [s4]

sections.title: Funding and fees
sections.text:
Amount and coverage [Conflict]
Published Graduate Center Fellowship total approximately$31,141 for fall/spring plus tuition and eligibility for
low-cost NYSHIP insurance. Source has inconsistent effective-date labels and pending PSC contract
implementation; salary increases March 1, 2027 and$4000 Dec 2026 lump sum are not a 2027 entrant
guarantee. Not every math admit receives stipend. [s6] [s7]
Years of support [Standing rule]
All math students receive five years tuition support; many additionally receive Graduate Center Fellowship.
Renewal depends satisfactory academic progress. [s5] [s7]
International eligibility [Standing rule]
GCF international visa holders receive out-of-state tuition up to 16 credits/semester for all five years. U.S.
citizens/PR must establish NY residency or pay rate difference after first year. [s7]
Conditions and duties [Standing rule]
Full-time registration≥7 credits/WIU; accept fellowship in CUNYfirst. Service: first-year research/program
assignment, years 2-4 teaching one course/semester, fifth-year service since Fall 2025. Insurance is low-cost
eligibility, not stated free coverage. [s7]

Extra funding application [Standing rule]
Institutional five-year merit packages automatically considered with admissions. [s4]
Other funding routes [Unresolved]
This particular funding term was not established by the public program/admissions material checked. Obtain
the exact rule in the funding offer or from the graduate coordinator; neither eligibility nor a guaranteed
amount/duration is inferred from silence. [s1] [s2] [s3]
Application fee [Standing rule]
$75 nonrefundable; pay credit card after submission or mailed check. [s3]
Fee waiver [Standing rule]
GC only lists U.S. Armed Services veterans and McNair Scholars: choose pay-by-mail/check, email
completed-application notice plus waiver status documentation; do not send check. No ordinary international
hardship waiver established. [s3]

sections.title: Potential advisers and recent research
sections.text:
Algebraic / arithmetic geometry
Andrew Obus
Arithmetic/non-Archimedean geometry, ramification and Galois covers, and regular models of curves. [faculty1]
[faculty1a]
Professor at Baruch; Graduate Center doctoral faculty. GC profile still says Associate Professor; title discrepancy does not
establish current student availability.
Research evidence: 2025 · Minimal regular normal crossings models of superelliptic curves
Official publication evidence for the stated research match.
Representation theory
Karol Kozioł
Mod-p representations of p-adic groups, derived Satake theory, and Hecke/Ext algebras. [faculty3] [faculty3a]
Assistant Professor at Baruch and listed GC doctoral faculty; availability unconfirmed.
Research evidence: 2025 · Derived Satake morphisms for p-small weights in characteristic p
Official publication evidence for the stated research match.

Published Graduate Center Fellowship total approximately$31,141 for fall/spring plus tuition and eligibility for
low-cost NYSHIP insurance. Source has inconsistent effective-date labels and pending PSC contract
implementation; salary increases March 1, 2027 and$4000 Dec 2026 lump sum are not a 2027 entrant
guarantee. Not every math admit receives stipend. [s6] [s7]
Years of support [Standing rule]
All math students receive five years tuition support; many additionally receive Graduate Center Fellowship.
Renewal depends satisfactory academic progress. [s5] [s7]
International eligibility [Standing rule]
GCF international visa holders receive out-of-state tuition up to 16 credits/semester for all five years. U.S.
citizens/PR must establish NY residency or pay rate difference after first year. [s7]
Conditions and duties [Standing rule]
Full-time registration≥7 credits/WIU; accept fellowship in CUNYfirst. Service: first-year research/program
assignment, years 2-4 teaching one course/semester, fifth-year service since Fall 2025. Insurance is low-cost
eligibility, not stated free coverage. [s7]

Extra funding application [Standing rule]
Institutional five-year merit packages automatically considered with admissions. [s4]
Other funding routes [Unresolved]
This particular funding term was not established by the public program/admissions material checked. Obtain
the exact rule in the funding offer or from the graduate coordinator; neither eligibility nor a guaranteed
amount/duration is inferred from silence. [s1] [s2] [s3]
Application fee [Standing rule]
$75 nonrefundable; pay credit card after submission or mailed check. [s3]
Fee waiver [Standing rule]
GC only lists U.S. Armed Services veterans and McNair Scholars: choose pay-by-mail/check, email
completed-application notice plus waiver status documentation; do not send check. No ordinary international
hardship waiver established. [s3]
